instruction:
You are tasked with designing a module that implements a simple 8-bit counter using Verilog. The counter should have the following functionality:

- The counter should count up from 0 to 255 and then wrap back to 0.
- The counter should have a synchronous reset input that resets the counter to 0 when asserted.
- The counter should have an enable input that allows the counter to count when asserted.
- The counter should have an output that represents the current count value.

Design a Verilog module that implements this counter functionality. Your module should only include standard Verilog constructs and should not require any external modules or libraries.
original_rtl:
module counter (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  input enable,
  output reg [7:0] count
);

  always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (reset) begin
      count <= 8'b0;
    end else if (enable) begin
      count <= count + 1;
    end
  end

endmodule
